Ilmainen juttu

The free opening paragraph of a story every reader may see. The library will stay open late on Thursdays from next month, the city announced after a long campaign by students and parents.

The free second paragraph goes on. Staff numbers will not change, and the extra hours are paid for by moving the Saturday morning opening to the afternoon, when more people visit.

The free closing paragraph ends the story. The trial runs until the summer, after which the board will look at visitor numbers and decide whether to keep the late evenings.
